findings.claim: The recorded quality gates do not satisfy the blocking workspace Rust checks required for a Rust code change.
findings.evidence: Constraints R1/R2 require `cargo check --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins -- -D warnings -W clippy::pedantic` to be clean for Rust code, but the receipt records only focused commands: `cargo test --offline -p frf-proto -p frf-domain -p frf-ports`, strict Clippy for those three crates, and `cargo check --offline -p frf-gateway -p frf-sdk-rust`.
findings.suggested_fix: Run and record the required workspace-level `cargo check --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins -- -D warnings -W clippy::pedantic` checks, plus the specified feature/tests clippy passes, and fix any resulting failures before marking task 5 complete.
